headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.
The reading fell short of a projection of 3.98 per cent from economists polled by financial data provider Wind. On a...
headlines.title_zh: 受燃料价格下跌影响，中国7月工业生产者出厂价格涨幅放缓至3.5%
headlines.summary_zh:
中国7月工业品出厂价格涨幅放缓，国内燃料价格下跌缓解了美以对伊朗战争引发的成本压力，而高温天气拖累制造业。
国家统计局发布的数据显示，7月工业生产者出厂价格指数（PPI）同比上涨3.5%，低于6月的4.1%

headlines.title_en: A-share market close: Three major indices warmed up in the afternoon, ChiNext closed up 1.12%, CPO sector strong all day
headlines.summary_en: A-share three major indices consolidated today; Shanghai Composite traded narrowly all day and turned positive at close, while ChiNext briefly fell after midday then regained momentum, rising over 1%. At close, Shanghai Composite rose 0.01%, Shenzhen Component rose 0.45%, ChiNext rose 1.12%; turnover exceeded 2.1 trillion yuan across Shanghai and Shenzhen, with over 2,300 stocks rising. On the board, electronic chemicals sector strengthened throughout the day, rare earth permanent magnets and CPO sectors opened high and performed strongly, while power and retail sectors were weak.

headlines.title: 财政部：集成电路企业、工业母机企业发生非货币性资产交换5年内转让所取得资产的 应停止执行分期纳税政策
headlines.summary: 财政部发布关于集成电路企业、工业母机企业非货币性资产交换企业所得税政策的公告，其中指出，集成电路企业、工业母机企业在2026年1月1日至2028年12月31日期间发生非货币性资产交换，按规定确认的非货币性资产交换所得，可在不超过5年期限内分期均匀计入相应年度的应纳税所得额，按现行政策规定计算缴纳企业所得税；企业进行非货币性资产交换所发生的损失，不得分期确认。集成电路企业、工业母机企业发生非货币性资产交换5年内转让所取得资产的，应停止执行分期纳税政策，并就分期纳税期内尚未确认的非货币性资产交换所得，在转让该资产当年的企业所得税年度汇算清缴时，一次性计算缴纳

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance: For integrated circuit enterprises and machine tool enterprises, if non-monetary asset swaps involve transferring acquired assets within 5 years, the phased tax payment policy should be discontinued
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance issued a notice on corporate income tax policies for non-monetary asset exchanges by integrated circuit enterprises and industrial machine tool enterprises, stating that gains from non-monetary asset exchanges recognized in accordance with regulations between Jan 1, 2026 and Dec 31, 2028 may be evenly included in taxable income over a period not exceeding 5 years, with tax calculated per current policies; losses from such exchanges may not be recognized in installments. If assets acquired through non-monetary asset exchanges are transferred within 5 years, the installment tax policy shall cease, and unrecognized gains from the exchange during the installment period shall be paid in a lump sum in the annual corporate income tax settlement of the year of transfer.

headlines.title: A股收盘：创业板指缩量涨超1%，算力硬件股集体走强
headlines.summary: 1、沪指全天探底回升，创业板指走势较强。CPO概念股走强，中石科技、剑桥科技等多股涨停。PCB概念股拉升，华正新材涨停，中富电路涨超10%。半导体芯片股拉升，蓝箭电子、联芸科技涨超10%。下跌方面，电力股集体调整，立新能源、华银电力接近跌停。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市超2900股飘绿，今日成交2.16万亿。截止收盘沪指涨0.01%，深成指涨0.45%，创业板指涨1.12%。 2、板块概念方面，CPO、光纤、存储芯片、PCB等板块涨幅居前，电力、影视、乳业、白酒等板块跌幅居前。 3、两市共2322只个股上涨，63只个股涨停，2720只个股下跌，10只个股跌停

headlines.title_en: A-share close: ChiNext Index rises over 1% on shrinking volume, computing hardware stocks rally broadly.
headlines.summary_en: 1. Shanghai Composite rebounded from lows throughout the day; ChiNext performed strongly. CPO concept stocks surged, with Sinchtech and CIG among many hitting limit up. PCB concept stocks rallied, Huazheng New Material hit limit up, Sunfonda Circuit rose over 10%. Semiconductor chip stocks advanced, Blue Arrow Electronics and Alcor Micro rose over 10%. On the downside, power stocks adjusted collectively, with Lixinneng and Huayin Electric near limit down. Decliners outnumbered gainers, with over 2,900 stocks falling across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing, turnover 2.16 trillion yuan. At close, Shanghai Composite rose 0.01%, Shenzhen Component rose 0.45%, ChiNext rose 1.12%. 2. By sector, CPO, fiber optics, storage chips, PCB led gains; power, film, dairy, baijiu led losses. 3. Across markets, 2,322 stocks rose, 63 hit limit up, 2,720 fell, 10 hit limit down

headlines.title: 工信部部长李乐成调研盐湖产业和工业绿色低碳发展
headlines.summary: 近日，工业和信息化部党组书记、部长李乐成赴青海、甘肃、宁夏等地调研盐湖产业和工业绿色低碳发展情况。他强调，要科学谋划盐湖产业发展战略，加强政策支持和要素保障，做优做强企业，促进资源整合和产业协同，攻坚盐湖资源开发关键核心技术，提高钾、锂、镁等资源开发利用效率和精深加工水平，打造特色优势产业链，构建技术先进、保障有力、绿色智能、效益一流的产业体系，全面提升产业国际竞争力，推动盐湖产业高质量发展迈上新台阶。

headlines.title_en: MIIT Minister Li Lecheng surveys salt lake industry and green low-carbon industrial development.
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Li Lecheng, Secretary of the Party Leadership Group and Minister of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, visited Qinghai, Gansu, Ningxia and other places to investigate the salt lake industry and industrial green low-carbon development. He emphasized scientifically planning the salt lake industry development strategy, strengthening policy support and factor guarantees, strengthening and optimizing enterprises, promoting resource integration and industrial synergy, tackling key core technologies for salt lake resource development, improving the efficiency and deep processing level of potassium, lithium, magnesium and other resource development and utilization, building distinctive advantageous industrial chains, constructing an industrial system with advanced technology, strong guarantees, green intelligence, and first-class efficiency, comprehensively enhancing international competitiveness, and pushing the high-quality development of the salt lake industry to a new level.
